title: Smart ATS Platform
description: A comprehensive applicant tracking and candidate pipeline platform. Built with full-stack MERN & TypeScript architectures, featuring automated candidate stage progression, resume parsing, interview evaluation workflows, and real-time dashboard analytics.

title: Enterprise Layered Architecture System
description: Production reference system implementing clean 4-tier layered architecture (Presentation Layer, Application Service Layer, Repository Layer, and Database Layer). Designed for high maintainability, testability, and enterprise scalability.

title: KnoitKeyboard — Smart Android Mobile Keyboard
description: An intelligent mobile keyboard application developed with Android Studio and Java. Features custom themes, responsive tactile feedback, localized input methods, gesture typing, and optimized Android input service lifecycle management.

title: Creative UI/UX & Digital Brand Showcase
description: Curated collection of digital product designs, glassmorphic design systems, mobile app prototypes, and brand identities published on Behance. Bridges creative visual aesthetics with technical front-end implementation.

title: Algorithms & Data Structures Repository
description: Comprehensive implementation of fundamental computer science algorithms and memory-efficient data structures in C and C++, covering binary search trees, graph algorithms, sorting techniques, and algorithmic complexity benchmarks.
